chapter_seo_title: Keke's Ordeal and Reunion at the Seven Demon Cities
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen discovers Keke's century of suffering and attacks the Otherworld forces guarding the seven demon cities, leading to a poignant reunion.
og_title: Keke's Ordeal: Seven Demon Cities Reunion
og_description: After a hundred millennia, Xiao Chen finds Keke trapped near the seven demon cities. A furious battle and tearful reunion unfold.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen's rage ignites as he learns of Keke's torment. A clash with stone men and a super-ancestral god ends in an emotional reunion.
